entities.summary: Gardaland is a theme park destination in Castelnuovo del Garda, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
entities.description: Italy’s most complete destination theme park, with strong family coverage and enough thrill depth for mixed-age groups. This entry is intended for 5–teen travel groups; current operating details, individual attraction restrictions and seasonal opening should be rechecked before travel.
entities.whyWorthwhile: Italy’s most complete destination theme park, with strong family coverage and enough thrill depth for mixed-age groups.

entities.summary: Leolandia is a children theme park destination in Capriate San Gervasio, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
entities.description: An unusually strong preschool and younger-child theme park with a ride mix and character environments calibrated to that audience. This entry is intended for 2–9 travel groups; current operating details, individual attraction restrictions and seasonal opening should be rechecked before travel.

entities.summary: Italia in Miniatura is a miniature world destination in Rimini, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
entities.description: A large, long-running miniature Italy with interactive features and enough scale to work as a family attraction rather than a brief model display. This entry is intended for 4–12 travel groups; current operating details, individual attraction restrictions and seasonal opening should be rechecked before travel.
